## Executive Summary
Ravindra Kumar is a top 1% Frontend Engineer and Website Developer specializing in building production-grade web applications, custom websites, accessible UI systems, and high-performance React architectures. With over 3 years of engineering experience, Ravindra has delivered enterprise portals, HIPAA-compliant healthcare applications, AI EdTech platforms, visual CMS dashboards, and luxury e-commerce websites.

## Core Technical Proficiencies
- **Core Languages & Libraries**: React.js (React 18/19), JavaScript (ES2024), TypeScript, HTML5 Semantic Elements, CSS3/Modern CSS.
- **Styling & Design Systems**: Tailwind CSS (v3 & v4), CSS Modules, WAI-ARIA Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance), Framer Motion, Shaders / WebGL.
- **Build Tools & Runtimes**: Vite 8, Node.js, Express.js, Bun, Webpack, npm, git.
- **State Architecture**: Zustand, TanStack Query (React Query), Context API, Redux Toolkit.
- **Web Performance & SEO**: Core Web Vitals Optimization (100% Mobile Scores, sub-second LCP, 0 CLS), Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD), Semantic Heading Architecture, Robots/Sitemap protocol.
- **API & Cloud Integration**: RESTful APIs, Axios, EmailJS, Vercel Edge, Firebase.

## Services Offered
1. **Full-Lifecycle Website Development**: Building modern, lightning-fast marketing sites, corporate portals, and landing pages with 95+ Core Web Vitals.
2. **Custom Web Application Development**: Architecting scalable Single Page Applications (SPAs) with complex state, authentication, and API integrations.
3. **Frontend Performance Auditing & Optimization**: Diagnosing and eliminating bundle bloat, render-blocking resources, forced synchronous reflows, and memory leaks.
4. **Figma to Pixel-Perfect React Implementation**: Translating complex UI/UX designs into accessible, responsive, composable React components.
5. **E-Commerce & Visual CMS Engineering**: Developing catalog browsers, product customizers, 3D flipbook viewers, and interactive customer portals.
